# 📖 `clever accesslogs` command reference

## ➡️ `clever accesslogs` <kbd>Since 2.1.0</kbd>

Fetch access logs

```bash
clever accesslogs [options]
```

### ⚙️ Options

|Name|Description|
|---|---|
|`--addon` `<addon-id>`|Add-on ID or real ID|
|`--after`, `--since` `<after>`|Fetch logs after this date/time (ISO8601 date, positive number in seconds or duration, e.g.: 1h)|
|`-a`, `--alias` `<alias>`|Short name for the application|
|`--app` `<app-id\|app-name>`|Application to manage by its ID (or name, if unambiguous)|
|`--before`, `--until` `<before>`|Fetch logs before this date/time (ISO8601 date, positive number in seconds or duration, e.g.: 1h)|

`clever accesslogs --format clf` now prints Common Log Format lines. I couldn't run or test it, because `node_modules` isn't installed here. That means `fix-all` and `validate` didn't run either (`eslint: command not found`).

- **New format value:** `src/commands/global.options.js` gets an `accessLogsFormatOption` that accepts `human`, `json`, `json-stream` and `clf`. I kept it separate from `logsFormatOption` so `clever logs` doesn't gain a `clf` value.
- **Formatter:** `src/commands/accesslogs/accesslogs.command.js` formats each entry as `ip - - [dd/Mon/yyyy:HH:mm:ss +0000] "METHOD path" status -`. Dates are UTC, and entries without an HTTP section are skipped, as with `human`.
- **Docs:** I edited the `--format` line in `accesslogs.docs.md` by hand to match what the generator should produce.

The Common Log Format has two fields I couldn't fill in correctly. I couldn't inspect the `@clevercloud/client` access-log shape, so I only used fields this repo already reads. The request line has no HTTP version (`"GET /path"`), and the bytes field is always `-`. Add them if the client exposes the protocol version and response size.

To finish, run `npm install`, then `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate`. The skill reference (`skills/clever-tools/references/full-documentation.md`) is generated, so `fix-all` should refresh it. I didn't touch it by hand.
